articleTitle: Bayesian ensemble assessment for credit scoring
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Credit scoring is explored to assess default risk of consumer behaviors for financial institutions, banks in particular. The advanced Bayesian algorithm is proposed for credit assessment. The new trial ensembles logistic regression analysis (LRA), cluster and MLP-NN in Bayesian approach as an advanced classifier. The investigation contain evidence that Bayesian ensemble technique optimizes LRA, cluster and MLP-NN consequence in credit assessment. Simultaneously, Bayesian approach creates positive advantage on algorithm accuracy and fitness for credit evaluation, nevertheless, balances and decreases classified error ratio (ER).

articleTitle: Intelligent manufacturing: The core leads industrial change in the future
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of new information technology, industrial change of intelligent manufacturing is arising around the whole world, which alters the manufacturing process, industrial chains and division system. Most developed countries speed up laying out industry and make new national strategies to revitalize manufacturing in order to promote the development of intelligent manufacturing and rebuild competitive advantages of manufacturing. `China Manufacturing 2025' aims at promoting manufacturing transformation and upgrading which focuses on intelligent manufacturing. In the following stage, pilot demonstration cities should be chosen which are concerned with new intelligent manufacturing modes such as discrete intelligent manufacturing, process intelligent manufacturing, networked collaborative manufacturing, mass customization, remote operation and maintenance service in order to advance development levels and boost the upgrading of industry.

articleTitle: Enhanced word embedding with multiple prototypes
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Word representation is one of the basic word repressentation methods in natural language processing, which mapped a word into a dense real-valued vector space based on a hypothesis: words with similar context have similar meanings. Models like NNLM, C&W, CBOW, Skip-gram have been designed for word embeddings learning, and get widely used in many NLP tasks. However, these models assume that one word had only one semantics meaning which is contrary to the real language rules. In this paper we pro-pose a new word unit with multiple meanings and an algorithm to distinguish them by it's context. This new unit can be embedded in most language models and get series of efficient representations by learning variable embeddings. We evaluate a new model MCBOW that integrate CBOW with our word unit on word similarity evaluation task and some downstream experiments, the result indicated our new model can learn different meanings of a word and get a better result on some other tasks.

articleTitle: Impact of FDI and export on economic growth: Evidence from Pakistan and India
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: FDI and export play the significant role in economic growth. This research synthesizes the relationship between FDI, export, and economic growth (per-capita income). For this purpose data were used from 1990–2015 which were obtained from World Bank indicators. Johansen cointegration, Granger causality, and unit root were applied for analyzing the results. The results reveal that Pakistan and India FDI and export have long term relationship with per-capita income. Granger casualty results demonstrate that Pakistan FDI and export has a unidirectional relationship with economic growth (Per capita income). The findings also recommend that Pakistan and India FDI have long run relationship with economic growth (Per capita income). The vector error correction model findings suggests that −27% changes in the short run to long run growth at an equilibrium point of Pakistan. India vector error correction model results also show that −31.1% short run to long run growth at the equilibrium point.

articleTitle: Analysis of fire safety risks in urban rail transit
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcoming of urban rail transit fire safety issues in the vulnerability, an improved method based on the improved theory of urban rail transit vulnerability assessment was proposed. First, the basic knowledge of the vulnerability of urban rail transit and its perturbation factors was introduced. Urban rail transit fire safety problem identification and control of the relevant three years of data were presented and applied. Second, a new method to verify the effectiveness of urban rail transit vulnerability control measures was given out. And it was employed into the urban rail transit control fire problem field. Third case analysis and validation of measures practice shows that method can solve urban rail transit fire safety problems related to the problem. And this work has of great significance in theory and practice.

articleTitle: Model research and policy recommendations of tailored taxi
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Because that the taxi industry generally appears a series of problems such as “difficult to take a taxi”, “high part money”, and the consumption demand presents the multi-level diversification trend as people income growth as well, the tailored taxi arose, remitting the contradiction of supply and demand of taxi service problems and providing people with a variety of service. But in the meantime, the tailored taxi lacks pre-service training and regulation of drivers, and the passenger themselves take great risk. The article main researches in the present operations and prospect of tailored taxi in domestic areas, and try to point out appropriate management and development advice and suggestions based on the characteristics and the game model of regulation, the advantages and disadvantages and the operation regulations of the tailored taxi.

articleTitle: Effect of tax burden on income management
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the Chinese market and the Chinese institutions, this paper intends to use the account error correction data to study the relationship between income management and tax burden. As revealed in the study, the underlying goal of income management for listed companies is the alleged increase in profits. However, most companies do not pay extra taxes, on the contrary, they reduce the tax report. There is a small amount of taxation on accounting income, so tax cuts may be attributed to profit management rather than objectives. The implication of this phenomenon is that the analysis of tax differences may be a useful tool for regulators to investigate income management behavior, investor and CPA assessment of accounting information quality, and tax authorities to supervise tax reporting.

articleTitle: Evolutionary game analysis of equity crowdfunding
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In order to study the investors' and agencies' dynamic strategies in the process of equity crowdfunding (EC), as well as to reveal contributory factors of their strategic behaviors, an evolutionary game model is built in this paper. This model theoretically analyzes two players' strategy selection behaviors as well as the behaviors' dynamic stability and influencing factors. The result shows that two players' choices are determined by the initial circumstance of the game and that the choices are sensitive to the threshold value of the saddle point. The paper also puts forward suggestions on the choices based on this research and real-world situations.

articleTitle: Credit model of supply chain finance based on big data of E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Supply chain finance, rapid developing in China in recent years, is not only one of the focuses in the financial innovation, but also an important theoretical research topic. This paper puts forward the three main participants in the supply chain finance: the leader enterprise, the follower, and the financial institution, then studies on three models: supplier dominated, dealer dominated and Business to Business electronic commerce platform dominated, then analyzes the advantages of the supply chain finance business based on Business to Business e-commerce, and establishes the credit model by the method of score card and econometric analysis as a result. Credit model is the core problem of the supply chain finance, being helpful to solve the widespread problem of financing difficulty of the small and medium-sized enterprises, and to promote the financial industry to serve the real economy better.

articleTitle: Gaming industry and economic growth: Evidence from Macau
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The aim of the study is to examine the causal relationship between gaming industry and economic growth in Macau over period from 1984 to 2015. The study finds the existence of long-run cointegration relationship. But, this study does not find the one- and two-directional causal relationship between GDP and gaming tax revenues. Furthermore, gaming tax revenues have short-run effect on GDP and slightly explain the percentage of variance. In general, Macau government should pay more attention on the development of gaming industry as the largest sector. According to the empirical results, this study suggests that Macau government should well conduct money supply (M2) in terms of currency in circulation to support the economic growth. Furthermore, Macau government should make effective strategies and plans to stimulate economic development using financial funding from banks.

articleTitle: The risk and prevention of internet finance
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Internet Finance promote the innovation and development of financial field, at the same time, it also has its own risks, such as system security risk, capital security risk, higher liquidity risk, market selection risk, monetary policy risk. So the internet financial supervision is very necessary, regulators should pay attention to the risk characteristics of the Internet financial regulation, establish and perfect the Internet financial laws and regulations system, effort to achieve targeted risk prevention.

articleTitle: Economy evaluation of distribution networks with distributed generation based on cost-benefit method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The widespread installation of distributed generation system is increasing challenges because of the potential cost and benefits. Although the cost of distributed generation is high, it can improve the reliability of power supply, reduce environmental pollution and bring more economic benefits to the society. Firstly, the impact of distributed generation on economy and reliability of distribution network is analyzed in this paper, and compared with the traditional thermal power generation. Then, the cost-benefit method is adopted and a comprehensive benefits model considering cost and benefits is proposed. The IEEE RBTS BUS6 F1 and F3 system is utilized as the distribution network case study, and the calculation results are presented and discussed. This model can be used in evaluating different projects.

articleTitle: Research on carbon emission evaluation of China's iron and steel industry
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: At present, China is the largest carbon emission country in the world. To adapt to the green new normal, solving the economic and environmental problem become a task of top priority. The paper calculates the carbon emission of China's iron and steel industry over the time period 1992-2012 by the IPCC empirical approach. We found that the carbon emissions increased rapidly during this time period, which had become one of the main source of carbon emission in China. In addition, this paper introduces the concept of urbanization and studies the long-term equilibrium relationship between carbon emissions and variables by optimizing KAYA identical equation. The results indicate that overcapacity affect heavily on the carbon emission of Chinese iron and steel industry. Dissolving the contradiction with overcapacity and ameliorating energy intensity can effectively control carbon emissions.

articleTitle: A comparative static analysis of the lemon market of translation services in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Translation services is playing a more and more crucial role with the growth of international trade and foreign direct investment. The rapidly growing literature on translation market is very fragmented and mainly accepted the hypothesis of information symmetry. Meanwhile translation services market is information asymmetry to some degree. This paper employs the comparative static method to explain the formation of lemon market in the field of translation services of China. After analyzing those reasons this paper tries to arrive at some advises for reducing information asymmetry of the market.

articleTitle: Role of ownership structure in firm R&D investment decision: Evidence from Chinese high-tech industry
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This empirical study investigates the influence of institutional and managerial ownership structures on firms' R&D investment decision and also moderating influence of state ownership among their relationship. We collect the data of 244 firms for the period of 2009 to 2015 from Chinese high-tech industry. We applied the fixed effect panel data model regression to test three hypothesis of the study. Empirical results of this study show that ownership structures such as institutional and also managerial have negatively and significantly influence on firm R&D investment. Furthermore, state ownership has positive moderation role in relation of institutional ownership with firm R&D investment while no moderating effect of state ownership in relationship among managerial ownership and firm R&D spending decision. This study will helps the policy makers to understand the various ownership structures effect firms' R&D investment decisions in Chinese high-tech industry.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis and experimental research on dynamic linewidth of DFB laser diodes under injection current tuning
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Aim at the problem that the dynamic linewidth measurement of distributed feedback tunable diode laser(DFB-TDL) with current tuning is quite difficult, based on the all-fiber delayed self-heterodyne interferometer (FDSHI) and no need an acousto-optic modulator (AOM), a simple measurement method is proposed. Firstly we present the theoretical analysis of the measurement principle and linewidth characteristics of lasers of the system, and the application of the measurement system of the dynamic linewidth of two DFB lasers tuning at different wavelengths. We then show the results of the comparison between the static linewidth and the dynamic linewidth measured by the Fabry-Perot etalon. The results show that the two lasers have similar laws that the dynamic linewidth increases with the increase of the injection current and then becomes wider and the dynamic linewidth is narrower than the static linewidth at the same injection current, and the difference between the dynamic linewidth and the static linewidth of the two lasers is 2MHz and 6MHz respectively.

articleTitle: An energy-saving association control algorithm for wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: An energy-efficient association control algorithm for wireless networks is proposed. Both the wake-sleep switch of each base station and the resource reservation overhead of its neighboring base stations are considered as factors to impact the base station on-off switch decision and the user association. The simulation results show that the overall system energy consumption can be reduced thanks to the base station sleeping and wakeup scheme while the system capacity is improved by help of taking neighboring base station resource occupation into account.

articleTitle: An order batching clustering algorithm of fixed maximum order number based on order picking system
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This research considering one working partition of order picking system as the research object, studies order batching problem and builds order batching model of fixed maximum order number. To solve the order batching model, the storage location similarity coefficient is token as clustering index, at the same time clustering algorithm is designed. This paper explores the application analysis of the algorithm and introduces case data. Simulation results indicate that clustering algorithm achieves effective order processing operations by combining small orders into batches. So that it has validity and feasibility to order picking.

articleTitle: How role ambiguity and role conflict effect creativity of employees in local domestic manufacturing industry: Evidence from Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: How different performance incidents of an individual are associated with role stress have obtained significant consideration. Role stress has significant impact on creativity of an individual but still it is not clear how exactly role stress is linked with employee's creativity because it has hardly ever been studied empirically. Our study explores the relation of main two factors of role stressors named as role-ambiguity & role-conflict influence on creativity of employees as well as role of mediating factors in their relationship. A survey conducted for data collection through pairs of questionnaires, one from employees and other from their respective managers of local manufacturing industry of Pakistan. We used SPSS. 19 for analysis to test our study hypotheses. Results of step-wise or hierarchal regression show that role ambiguity is negatively whereas role conflict is positively associated with creativity of employees.

articleTitle: Special features of industrial security of urban public transport
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: As a type of municipal public utilities, urban public transport is looking at more interventions from the government in many countries. Its industrial security should be paid more attention to in the studies of industrial security. The paper aims at defining industrial security of urban public transport and discovering its unique features on the basis of analyzing the factors affecting it and their impacts. Industrial security of urban public transport refers to the state of the operation and development of urban public transport in a city, region or country without serious risks resulting from environmental factors or internal industrial factors. Such factors have different impacts. Seeing from these factors and their impacts, industrial security of urban public transport is mainly featured by weak foreign-related character, complexity and particularity.

articleTitle: The relationship between industrial structure upgrading and metropolitanization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The upgrading of industrial structure is closely related to the development of metropolitanization. This paper takes Beijing as an example to carry on the empirical research, analyzes the industrial structure and research the relationship between the upgrading of industrial structure and metropolitanization development. It shows that the development of the tertiary industry and the secondary industry are related to metropolitanization. Meanwhile the causality test shows that the development of the tertiary industry has a direct impact on the urbanization process, but the upgrading of the urbanization has not led to the development of the tertiary industry. Therefore, this paper draws up the industrial upgrading strategy to promote the process of metropolitanization.

articleTitle: Investigation and analysis on the utilization situation of medical services in urban and rural residents
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the field research data of more than 20 counties and cities in Anhui Province, the empirical test is carried out for the utilization status of different groups of medical services by seemingly unrelated regression model. The study shows that there is a high similarity between the agricultural registered population and the urban flexible employed population in the medical service utilization but there is a great difference between urban formal employed populations in the medical service utilization. Therefore, it shall be started from strengthening awareness of health maintenance and investment for rural residents, improving the income level of rural residents and breaking the restrictions of resource utilization and allocation difference such as medical caused by household registration system to gradually achieve urban and rural integrated medical security system and promote the sustainable development of medical security system and the establishment of harmonious society.

articleTitle: Research on life cycle of power financial products based on block chain factor
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Block chain technology has become a hot research in recent years, and its development will affect the whole society. In this paper, the new Life Cycle model of Power Internet Financial Products was proposed under the Block Chain effects. Some results are based on econometric mathematical model and economic principles. Meanwhile, we predict the lifecycle curve of Internet financial products based on real Power user numbers from State Grid. The results of this paper have a high reference value for the development of power finance.

articleTitle: On systematic risks of bank bankruptcy in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: By analyzing the factors for the risk of bank bankruptcy in China, this paper points out that the bankruptcy risk in Chinese banking appears in the form of a chaotic system. In bank operation, risk factors influence one another, and get aggravated along, so it is hard to distinguish the initial risk. Therefore, to handle related risks, it is a must to start with each and every risk factor.

articleTitle: The equivalence between Mann-Whitney Wilcoxon test and score test based on the proportional odds model for ordinal responses
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The two-group comparison remains to be one of the most basic tasks in statistical analysis. In comparing the distribution of ordinal responses between two groups, Mann-Whitney Wilcoxon test is often used for hypothesis testing, while the proportional odds model is employed for characterizing the between group difference. This synthetic approach raises an important question that whether the results from these two methods are always consistent in analyzing the same data. In this paper, we provide the theoretical justification that both the nonparametric Mann-Whitney Wilcoxon test and the score test of the proportional odds model depends on the proportion of pairs in which the response from one group is higher than that in another group and are equivalent. This result guarantees the asymptotical consistency of the two steps of the synthetic approach. We also use simulation study and real data example to further confirm the equivalence of two tests in finite samples.

articleTitle: Static and dynamic analysis of intra industry trade of aquatic products between China and ASEAN based on the belt and road initiative
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the favorable background of the Belt and Road Initiative, the aquatic products trade between China and ASEAN is facing a historic opportunity. In order to make guidance of transformation for the aquaculture enterprises, this article thoroughly make static and dynamic analyses on the situation of intra-industry trade of aquatic products between China and ASEAN based on the HS classification, by calculating the Grubel-Lloyd Intra-Industry Trade Index, Bruelhart Marginal Intra-Industry Trade Index and Thom-McDowell Horizontal and Vertical Intra-Industry Trade Index successively. The results show the intra-industry trade of aquatic products between China and ASEAN is mainly of vertical and is mainly derived from the difference of resource endowment.

articleTitle: The PPP project renegotiation analysis based on the asymmetric game model
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: financial management; investment; international trade; organisational aspects; railways; government policies; economic indicators; transportation; game theory; econometrics.

articleTitle: Research on portfolio management of university education funds taking harvard university for example
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Foundation Management Regulation has promulgated since 2004. University education foundations have sprung up, especially among the 985 and 211 key universities The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Education have implemented donation matching policy towards subordinate universities since 2009, leading to a rapid growth of donated funds. The university education fund starts to put attention on the operation of the increasingly accumulated funds. This paper takes Harvard University education fund as an example, analyzing its portfolio management and investment strategy and giving some advices on the management of university education fund in China.

articleTitle: The population aging and its effects on household consumption in Shandong province
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The goal in this series is to analyze whether the level of consumption is affected by the aging population. This paper selects aging population rate of 1995-2014 in Shandong province, consumer price index and the growth rate of per capita GDP to make empirical analysis by using unit root test, co-integration theory and error correction model on the relationship between consumption level, per capita GDP growth rate and aging population. The findings indicate that there is stable relationship for a long period between per capita consumption, aging population rate and per capita GDP growth rate in Shandong province.

articleTitle: Internet platform business model renovate catering industries: Evdience from 3199 catering enterprises on Dianping.com in Haidian district
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Catering industry as a basic service industry have been playing an indispensable role in national economy development. With Chinese economy has entered “the new normal”, comprehensive Revenue Management becoming more and more important. “Internet +” platform business model provides a precious opportunity for traditional catering enterprises restructuring and upgrading. The third-party internet platform can mobilize fragmentation resources, optimize operation flow and reduce marketing costs. Catering companies who using the Internet platform well can expand brand influence and increase revenue. Enterprise with respective conditions commonly choice different platform function. Popularity restaurants use group purchase more. Inexpensive restaurant like selling takeaway. Low popularity restaurant performed poor in the use of platform.

articleTitle: The function of agricultural carbon sink and its ecological compensation mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The paper presents a critical issue to establish a complete ecological compensation mechanism in order to develop and actualize the function of agricultural carbon sink, which is analyzed with the potential capacity of carbon emission reduction. A strategy is put forward to improve the mechanism of ecological compensation to agricultural carbon sink.

articleTitle: Study on the influencing factors of commodity housing price taking Hebei Province as a sample
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Since 1998, our country canceled the welfare housing distribution policy, commercial housing market investment scale expanded rapidly. The real estate market has been developing increasingly, gradually become the pillar industry of national economy. But in recent years, most urban property prices rose rapidly in our country, as a result, the price level had far beyond the economic capacity of most residents. So house prices problem gradually evolved into a serious economic and social problem, which directly affected the quality of life of residents. The influence factors of commodity housing price also attracted the wide attention of the whole society. There are many factors that affect the price of commodity housing, and three major factors are involved in this paper. Meanwhile, combined with years of commercial housing price data, the price trend in recent years are analyzed. Taking Hebei Province as a sample, the present situation and problems of the commercial housing market in the province are analyzed. According to the analysis conclusion and the current situation of commercial housing in Hebei, at the end of this paper, we give some suggestions on the regulation of Hebei commodity housing market.

articleTitle: Research on the triggering factors of PPP in urban mass transit
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: PPP (Public-Private-Partnership) can make full use of social idle funds and improve the efficiency of public goods supply. In recent years, PPP has been widely used in the field of infrastructure, but in 39 cities which with urban rail transit in only a few cities using the PPP. Therefore, exploring the triggering factors of PPP in urban rail transit has important theoretical and practical significance, which provides theoretical basis for the successful implementation and management of urban rail transit PPP project.

articleTitle: Research on capital structure security evaluation of China's auto industry
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of China's auto industry control right caused by the introduction of foreign capital, based on defining China's auto industry capital structure security, in this paper we construct China's auto industry capital structure security index system containing 6 indexes, identify the index warning limit and index positive management method and finally use the principal component analysis to comprehensively measure China's auto industry capital structure security. The findings show that China's auto industry capital structure security situation has not fundamentally improved. The research is of important theoretical value and practical value for solving China's auto industry security problem.

articleTitle: Circulation mode selection based on cost analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The rapid development of the logistics industry promotes the nationwide circulation of the fresh agricultural products. The price of fresh agricultural product in different circulation modes is distinct. Aiming at this kind of phenomenon, this paper puts forward a model of selecting the best circulation mode according to the cost analysis. Use the fresh agricultural product's circulation structure with the ISM (Interpretative Structural Modeling), and then add the cost constraints of transportation, storage and time, get the common cost formula about different circulation modes. And taking apple circulation process as an example, explain how to select the mode of distribution.

articleTitle: An evaluation research of the effect of Hangzhou Metro Line 1 after applying the PPP model a comparative analysis with Beijing Metro Line 4
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Beijing Metro Line 4 was the first metro line in China's orbit traffic industry to be built under the PPP project financing model. Hangzhou Metro Line 1 copied and borrowed the former's model. But Hangzhou Metro Line 1 has been in the red for a long time, and even became the only defective metro line in the four affiliated orbit traffic companies to MTR Corporation Limited in 2014. Given the situation, this paper adopts the comparison method, and collects concurrent data on Beijing Metro Line 4 and Hangzhou Metro Line 1 before making a comprehensive evaluation of the data from different angles and an in-depth analysis of the reasons for such result.

articleTitle: Security evaluation of China's futures industry under the new normal
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The security situation of China's futures industry is currently in good condition on the whole, with strong industrial competitiveness and control force, as well as low external dependency. However, under the new normal, there still exist some problems, such as fewer trading varieties of futures, irrational investor structure and the slow internationalization process and so on. So we must accelerate the introduction of futures variety, constantly optimize investor structure, and speed up the internationalization process of futures market, in order to bring into full play the futures market's functions of hedging, price discovery and investment. On in this way, can the futures industry adapt to the requirements of transformation of economic development mode, and ensure the sound and rapid development of Chinese economy.

articleTitle: Application of interval number theory in investment combination model
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The idea of investment diversification has existed for a long time, as “do not put all eggs in the same basket.” as what we often say. Traditional investment management focuses on the combination of multiple securities, but it puts more emphasis on individual security, as the simple assembly of individual management. Investment combination theory regards combination as one entity, and pays attention to the balance between earnings and risks of the combination entity. As an extremely complex system, on the security market, securities' earnings and risks are both characterized with uncertainty, which is difficulty in decision-making analysis researches. Moreover, uncertainty of events mainly has two presentation forms: First, uncertainty whether the events happen or not, i.e., randomness. Second, uncertainty of event's state, i.e., fuzziness. Investment combination selection is about investor's investment decision-making in the uncertain environment. Now, the researches on investment combination based on random uncertainty have been well-improved, and those based on fuzzy uncertainty have gradually obtained extensive understanding and concerns. The paper focuses on investor's internal uncertainty. The investor may be optimistic, pessimistic or compromising, and even more elaborate. The paper will conduct modeling analysis of different investors' thoughts, aiming at effectively combining interval number theory and investment combination theory.

articleTitle: Analysis of serious disease security of rural residents based on happiness
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Happiness is affected by subjective feelings and objective conditions. While the health, wealth risks and so on that come along with serious diseases are important indexes affecting each factor of sense of happiness. It needs to build up happiness index to measure the influence of serious disease on happiness index of rural residents. The attained data conclusions have proposed optimized and improved suggestions for building up a more scientific and reasonable serious disease security mechanism as well as the policy direction for promoting happiness of rural residents.

articleTitle: Evolution mechanism and simulation of urban logistics industry agglomeration area ecosystem based on CAS
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The urban logistics industry agglomeration area ecosystem is an industrial ecosystem with such functions as self-organization, self-regulation and self-adaption. It is composed of enterprises and supporting institutions related to the city logistics industry chain. This paper analyzes the evolution mechanism of urban logistics industry agglomeration area ecosystem, and builds the evolution model by using the complex adaptive system (CAS) theory, and applies Netlogo software to simulate the process for getting the general evolution rule of urban logistics industry agglomeration area ecosystem. The proposed method can reveal the evolution rules and trends of urban logistics industry agglomeration area ecosystem and offer the accurate basis for making policy.

articleTitle: The research on the efficiency of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei traffic integration
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper uses Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to empirically analysis the efficiency of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei traffic integration and the results are as follows. Firstly, the railway network is running well while the difficulties to alleviate the contradiction between supply and demand of the highway transport has existed for a long time, and the homogenization of competition in the port construction is one of the burning issues of our times. Secondly, the scale ratio of transportation system within the region is not reasonably adapted, and increasing infrastructure investment is conducive to the rapid advance of the regional integration at present. Finally, according to the issues above, this paper proposes three suggestions.

articleTitle: Value-for-Money assessment in China's public-private-parternship project present situation, problems and policy suggestions
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Since 2014, China's National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Finance have been promoting the Public-Private-Partnership (PPP) mode. Value-For-Money (VFM) assessment is one of the indispensable assessment in the PPP project operation process, which provide powerful guidelines for the project decision through the quantitative or qualitative analysis. However, the period of China adopting PPP model is shorter, the design of VFM assessment still exist many problems. This paper summarizes the current situation of VFM assessment in international, introducing the VFM assessment in China, analyzing the problems in the design of China's VFM assessment system, and puts forward some reasonable solutions to improve the application of VFM assessment in China's PPP projects.

articleTitle: Guidance of the coordination theory of man-land relationship to land exploitation and utilization
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Man-land relationship reflects the interdependence and interaction between man and nature. This paper gives an overview of the definition of human-land relationship and its characteristics, and analyzes the contradictions and problems in the process of exploitation and utilization of land. Combined with this basis and the guidance of the coordination theory of man-land relationship, this paper puts forward some suggestions on the human exploitation and utilization of land.

Author Keywords: the coordination theory of man-land relationship

articleTitle: Study on risk spillover effects of shadow banks on traditional banks in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper selected the 29 shares of listed companies as samples, including 13 shadow banks. This paper will use the company's shares daily closing price as the research sample and use GARCH model to calculate the VaR and CoVaR value of the company's share price gains. The empirical results show that compared with the traditional banking institutions, shadow banking institutions risk spillover effect more big, the banking supervision departments should strengthen the regulation of such institutions to prevent the happening of the financial crisis.

articleTitle: Analysis of port pricing based on circle model
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the circle model, three models of port pricing strategy are established by using game theory. The results show that the two ports will choose their best service quality when they both choose the single price strategy or the differential price strategy. The Nash equilibrium of the whole industry will develop towards higher service quality. Moreover, when ports implement differential pricing, the price for consumers in indirect hinterland will be the unit cost. When the service quality is the same, the two ports will choose the single price strategy. The service quality, quality cost coefficient and waiting time coefficient decide whether to form a combined port charging the unified price. But when the service quality is different, the two ports will consider the service quality, quality cost coefficient and waiting time coefficient to decide the pricing strategy.

articleTitle: Transportation and domestic tourism inequality in China, 2006–2014
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper discusses the interpretation for the Theil index, and takes the length of highways as prior probability, reveals the tendency and composition of domestic tourism in China from 2006 to 2014. Based on the results, the construction of transportation infrastructure in Western China is emphasized.

articleTitle: An econometric analysis of the impact of entrepreneurship on employment in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In recent years, Hebei Province introduced a series of policies to encourage entrepreneurship. Entrepreneurship is the basic quality of entrepreneurs. This paper will use the econometric to analyze the effect of entrepreneurial spirit to Hebei Province on employment on the time series data, and put forward related advice. The empirical analysis shows that entrepreneurial spirit and innovative spirit of entrepreneurs in Hebei Province have a significant impact on the employment situation.

articleTitle: Study on the present situation and problems of the employment of the disabled in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: According to the second national sample survey of disabled people, the number of disabled people reaches 82,960,000 in China, which accounts 6.34% of the total population In the same year, the number of disabled people from Beijing is 999,000, which accounts for 6.49% of all populations of the city. If calculated according to the proportion, the number of people of disabled people would be reach 1,409,000 in 2017. In this paper, the employment data of disabled people from Beijing Federation are used to analyze the employment situation and problem. The research results show that the lower employment rate and level, the lower social security and the less training are the main problems of employment for disabled people. Finally, several suggestions which strengthen the vocational training and improve the social security level are proposed to realize the full employment and protect the rights of disable people.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of industrial structure in Liaoning Province
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The shift-share analysis method is the basic method to study industrial structure and industry competition. In this paper, we use the shift-share analysis method to analysis the Liaoning Province's industrial structure. We can draw the following conclusions, Due to historical influences, the first and second industrial structure of Liaoning province is irrational. The industrial structure and competitiveness of the third industry are relatively strong. Therefore, the government departments in Liaoning should adjust the industrial structure of the first and second industries. At the same time, we should develop the third industry, especially the financial industry and service industry.

articleTitle: Financial risk evaluation upon agricultural products supply chain: An analysis based on uncertain type analysis of hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper firstly studies financial risk cognition of the agricultural products supply chain, and then proposes four sources of agricultural products supply chain financial risks. Furthermore, this paper builds the financial risk evaluation index system of agricultural products supply chain. The index system of financial risks includes: financial risks of external environment, credit risk of processing enterprise, credit risk of peasant household and operation risk of supply chain. This index system defines index coefficient through Uncertain Type Analysis of Hierarchy Process (UTAHP), and this index system represents five risk grades. In this way, we can propose one scientific means to define financing risk of agricultural products supply chain. At last, this paper utilizes the method of empirical study to testify the financial risk evaluation indexes of agricultural supply chain. The analyzed object is one famous enterprise whose name is Liu He Group. Based on the empirical study above, we come to a conclusion that the bank should provide financial service for the supply chain.

articleTitle: A research on audio-visual product industry ideology's security
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The ideology carried by audio-visual product has a strong influence and guidance function. This paper starts from make a basic overview on audio-visual product industry ideology's security, construct the evaluation system of audio-visual product industry security, analyze the current situation and existing problems of audio-visual product industry ideology's security in China, and puts forward an optimization way of improve the ideology's security of audio-visual product industry. It has great significance for audio-visual industry development.

articleTitle: Regional trade flow and the hierarchical structure of China's high-speed rail hub
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In this paper, the national hub cities, regional hub cities and district hub cities were analyzed. We used the gravity model to estimate trade flows between hub cities. We focused on the analysis of the trade structure characteristics for the hierarchy structure of the high-speed rail hub cities, and then set a regional trade difference index and regional integration index. The results show that the regional trade between high-speed rail hub cities has grade difference and spatial agglomeration characteristics. The developing of high-speed rail network has improved economies scale of hub cities, strengthen the function of hub, expend the range of hub Market and promote the balanced trade development in other cities, and also improved the China's overall level of regional economic integration. The high-speed rail is conducive to the coordinated development of the national economy. But at the same time, there are some negative externalities. It increases the difference of regional hub cities. Therefore, in the development of high-speed rail, the government should introduce more targeted policies to guide the rational layout of the industry, to promote the coordinated development of regional economy.

articleTitle: The influence of cultural industrial policies on the security of cultural industrial structure
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The security of cultural industrial structural is one of the important contents of cultural industry research. On the basis of defining the security of cultural industrial structure, this paper analyzes the cultural industry policy factors which affect the security of cultural industry structure. They are talent policies, fiscal and financial policies, incentives and incentives policies, and international trade policies.

articleTitle: Based on large passenger flow research on safety operation of urban rail transit
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of large passenger traffic caused by the safety of urban rail transit, based on an improved method, the theory of vulnerability and the theory of mutation are put forward. First, the basic knowledge of urban rail transport introduces traffic problems and loopholes. Then, a new vulnerability theory is based on the mutation theory. And it is used for traffic problems in the field of urban rail transit operations. 3 years of data on the safe transportation of urban rail transit applications. Based on the above methods, an example of urban rail transit safety is analyzed. The final fragile urban rail transit subway station is sorted. Urban rail transit subway traffic control measures proposed and verified. An example shows that the algorithm method can solve this problem. Our work has been in theory and practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on the differential control of construction land based on regional differentiation of ultimate demand and supply
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Due to the difference of economic development and resource endowment in different regions, it will not be advantageous for different regions carry out coordinated development if taking the homogeneous land use control policy. In order to coordinate the regional sustainable development, this paper constructs the model of supply and demand about construction land in different provinces through forecasting the scale of supply and demand of construction land in 31 provinces municipalities and autonomous regions, then classifies different levels of the management and control areas about construction land, exploring the methods of the management of construction land according to the local conditions. The results show that there are significant differences in the supply and demand of each region. The area of potential mining provinces is concentrated in the southeastern coastal areas and the Beijing-Tianjin area. The index newly-added provinces are concentrated in the traditional areas of the Central Plains (Yangtze River and the Yellow River basin). The area of utility enhancement is located in the inland areas of China. The ecological conservation areas are located in the Midwest Plateau region. Local governments of different levels should make different construction land control policies according to their conditions of regional resource endowment and social and economic development characteristics.

articleTitle: A study on the impact of financial environment on the upgrading of high tech industries in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This thesis studies the relationship between the financial ecological environment and the upgrading of high-tech industries by Granger causality test with a construction of index system about financial ecological environment (including government governance, economic foundation, financial development, social credit and legal environment) and high technology industrial upgrading based on the relevant data from 1995 to 2014. The results of the study are that changes in the financial ecological environment, economic foundation, financial development and social credit are the cause of changes of new products of high technology industry sales and that changes in government governance and legal environment had no significant effect on the sales of new products of high technology industry changes. According to the empirical results and the current problems existing in financial ecological environment of Beijing, some proposals are put forward to lower the impact of government debt on financial stability, improve the financial market and the credit system and optimize the protection of intellectual property rights.

articleTitle: Research on optimal model construction of electronic super-sovereign currency
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the emergence and development of electronic currency, especially bitcoin turning out, it provided a new way of thinking for the realization of the super-sovereign currency [1]. In this situation, what is the evolution trend of the optimal monetary model? What is the construction of electronic super-sovereign currency? What is the new development of the traditional super-sovereign currency theories? This paper aims to solve these problems.

Author Keywords: reform of the international monetary system

articleTitle: Empirical study on China's financial risk early warning under the new normal
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In this paper, we construct the financial risk early warning model based on BP neural network, make an empirical analysis of the data between January 2004 and October 2015, proves the reliability of the model prediction results through the training and test of the financial risk early warning model and finally put forward the following suggestions for preventing China's financial risks under the new normal: to reform the current financial supervision mode, to adapt to the mixed operation management demand; to construct the financial risk early warning system suitable for China's reality; the “one bank and three commissions” (which refers to the People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission and China Insurance Regulatory Commission) should constantly improve supervision means and technology, strengthen inter-departmental coordination and enhance financial supervision efforts.

articleTitle: Granger causality test of the relationship between export and economic growth in Central Jiangsu Region
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: By using the co-integration analysis technique and Granger causality test method, this paper conducts empirical analysis of export and economic growth in Central Jiangsu Region. The result shows that there is a co-integration relationship between export and economic growth in Central Jiangsu Region, but export growth is not the main cause of economic growth. In accordance with this result, efforts should be made to improve the export of Central Jiangsu Region, so that export growth can promote the economic growth, and corresponding policies and suggestions are also proposed.

articleTitle: Game theoretical analysis on the projects of knowledge transfer among public housing
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Knowledge of a public housing project is very precious resources for other projects. Due to the public housing projects built by different enterprises, enterprises are not willing to transfer knowledge. To solve this problem, this paper uses the method of game theory to analyze the enterprises' knowledge transfer strategy choice, then analyze the dynamic equilibrium point and evolutionary path. Based on the results, this paper proposes some suggestions in order to promote the knowledge transfer among the public housing projects.

articleTitle: A method to estimate directional interaction of urban network
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Spatial interaction research mainly focuses on showing the interaction relationship between regions. However, classic urban interaction models such as gravity model can only compute symmetric result between two regions, paying no attention on much individual phenomenon during region evolution process. Since radiation model proposed in 2012 can simulate directional, asymmetric urban interaction with O-D result, we improved and applied the radiation model to simulate the population movement between 333 cities in China in 2000 and 2010 to construct directed weighted network of the cities interaction in terms of population, and then utilized indicators of complex network to estimate the development during the ten years and the developmental differences between regions. The conclusion of this research is that the interaction intensity between cities in China rises dramatically from 2000 to 2010, during which balanced regional development becomes a macroscopical trend, and now in China, the east develops better than the west, and the south develops faster than the north.

articleTitle: Impacts of inter-governmental transfer on income of rural households
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The most fundamental reasons for financial support for agricultural development include ensuring national food security and increasing rural incomes. The designated use of special transfer payments will be more conducive to the goal of increasing food production and increasing the incomes of farmers. However, such problems as here are many problems such as the inefficiencies in the use of agricultural related transfer payments and the urgent need to reform the agricultural related transfer payments. In order to solve these problems, this thesis put forward that inter-governmental grants in agricultural field should be operated with block grants rather than the current specific grants.

articleTitle: Research on VFM quantitative evaluation of urban rail transit using PPP mode taking Taiyuan Metro Line 2 as an example
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: According to the status of the implementation of PPP projects and the application of VFM in China, this paper proposes a VFM model to quantitatively evaluate the appropriateness of the PPP financing model and the specific mode of operation. According to the VFM model proposed in this paper, the public sector comparative value (PSC value) and the present value of the government's net cost in the whole life cycle are calculated respectively from the PPP project of urban rail transit (PPP value), then the value of the VFM is calculated. According to the evaluation results, it is possible to determine whether the urban rail transit construction project is suitable for adopting PPP mode. Taking the Taiyuan Metro Line 2 as an example, the VFM model is used to analyze and discuss the project, which proves the feasibility and applicability of the VFM model.

articleTitle: Study on challenges and strategies of China's high-tech industry
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: High-tech industry has become a key component of international competitiveness of one country. This paper analyses the general development of China's high-tech industry and compares it with strong competitive high-tech industries of other countries. And then this paper reveals major problems and challenges faced by China's high-tech industry and also provides strategies for high-tech industry per its disadvantages and the trend of manufacturing development in China.

articleTitle: Regional industry network construction and industrial structure change analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the complex network theory, this paper constructs the regional industry network by using the 2009-2014 corporate transfer data between enterprises of a bank in Yiwu, explores its topology structure, and analyzes the industrial structure change through the construction of homogeneous and heterogeneous networks. The result shows that 2012 as the boundary, the integral characteristic of industry network in Yiwu has periodic change. Most of industries in Yiwu break through the relation pattern and develop new contact on the basis of original relationship so that the key basic industries be diversified gradually. Wholesaling and manufacturing are the most important industries in local economy.

articleTitle: The effects of financial leverage to investment expenditure under the background of ownership concentration based on empirical data in real estate companies
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the characteristics of capital intensive and highly dependent on the financial leverage in the real estate business, it is important for real estate companies to take advantage of financial leverage to make accurate investment decisions and maintain stable operations. This study is conducted in the context of equity concentration, from the principal-agent theory, the conflict between the shareholders and the agencies by mandate of manager level is not the main contradiction, so this study focuses on the effects of financial leverage to investment outlays through the perspective of contradictions between real estate enterprises' controlling shareholders and minority shareholders and contradictions between the controlling shareholders and agencies between creditors.

articleTitle: The impact of construction waste discharge and penalty changes on enterprises reduction behavior
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In order to study the impact of construction waste discharge and penalty changes on enterprises reduction behavior, construct and analyze the evolutionary game model of government and enterprises, find that the sum of the discharge rate and the proportion of the penalty is one of the main factors influencing the enterprises reduction behavior changes, and the impact of its change on enterprises reduction behavior is related to the inspecting cost. So the government adjusts the charge policy, also need to adjust the inspecting cost simultaneously, so can ensure that enterprises actively participate in the construction waste reduction activities.

articleTitle: A time series approach for risk forecasting of individual stocks in the new three board market
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Time-series analysis is an important topic that has attracted huge interest in financial and economic analysis domain. In this paper, a three-phase time series approach is proposed to predict the stock price distribution in New Three-Board market. First of all, the close price time series were performed by the differential pre-processing to get the stock price change percent time series. Then the pre-processed time series were tested for stationarity. Finally, we use the time series analysis method to predict the probability of future change percent based on the historical probability distribution curve. Empirical analysis shows that our method can effectively prevent the risk of individual stocks in China New Three-Board market.

articleTitle: Research on the risk of the new OTC market in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: After years of development as the main force over the counter market, now the National Equities Exchange and Quotations, commonly known as the new over-the-counter market, has formed a fairly large scale. The number of enterprises grows rapidly and there have been more than 10000 enterprises in the new over-the-counter market today, bringing the trading boom. However, in the thriving new over-the-counter trading, it must be recognized that there are still a lot of risk factors, restricting the market developing healthy and orderly. This paper starts with the current situation of the new over-the-counter market of our country, focusing on the research of the liquidity risk and the valuation risk of the medium-sized and small enterprises share transfer system by means of statistical analysis and comparative analysis. And then analyzes the causes of risk in-depth and proposes some policy recommendations of the market risk prevention and control. Hope to help the market participants understand more about the risk of the new over-the-counter market, especially develop the risk awareness of the market participants, and finally take the risk prevention and control actively. At the same time, the China new over-the-counter market risk prevention and control model would be established and improved, and as a result, it can provide strong financial support for the development of emerging industries, small and medium enterprises and escort the construction of China capital market.

articleTitle: The impact of FDI on international industrial competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Utilizing data of Chinese manufacturing from 2000 to 2014, the impact of FDI on international industrial competitiveness is analyzed in this paper by co-integration test and error correction model. The results show that FDI has a long-run equilibrium relationship with revealed comparative advantage index and international market share, and short-term change in FDI also has a significant impact on them. This indicates FDI is an important factor which affects the industrial international competitiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis on contribution measure of YUXINOU international railway to Chongqing's foreign trade
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The development of foreign trade is inseparable from the transportation. Chongqing, as a southwest inland city, plays an important role in YUXINOU international railway. And it also has made a considerable progress on foreign trade after decades of the reform and opening-up policy. This paper takes the YUXINOU as the study subject and uses the econometric model analysis method to study the relationship between transportation and foreign trade in Chongqing. Finally, we can get the inclusion that YUXINOU international railway has a positive impact on Chongqing's foreign trade.

articleTitle: Research on economics of national development zones under supply reform based on the panal data of Hubei province
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The results of the fixed-effect model of panel data statistical analysis for the national development zones in Hubei province showed that the production function of was increasing returns to scale, the output elasticity of land and fixed assets investment were similar but far less than labor. Based on the comparative analysis of the eight economic indicators of efficiency of land during 2007 to 2014, some countermeasures and suggestions were put forward to promote the development of national development zone in Hubei province.

articleTitle: A study on shadow banking scale and risk in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In this paper, the closing price of a total of 28 listed companies including 16 traditional banks and 12 shadow banks in China are selected as the study samples to construct the GARCH model and calculate the VaR values of these 28 banks of shadow banks on traditional banks. The empirical results show that risks faced by China's shadow banks are up to three times higher than those faced by traditional banks. On the other hand, as shadow banks and traditional banks are highly correlated and risks are contagious, the shadow banks will have risk spillover effects on other financial subjects. Accordingly, we should improve the shadow banking legal system and supervision framework to adapt to the financial system reform; the non-traditional credit creation mechanism within the banking system is the focus of the supervision of the shadow banking system in the future; we should adjust the financial supervision model in a timely manner and gradually change from separate supervision to comprehensive supervision; we should improve the internal control mechanism of shadow banking based on supervision improvement.

articleTitle: The effect of air quality index on return rate of China stock market: Empirical test based on GARCH model
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Continuous haze in China has become a social concern that affects people's moods and behavior. This paper uses GARCH model to examine whether air quality can be a proxy variable of emotion to affect stock market. The paper compounds national Air Quality Index (AQI) weighted by the proportion of investors in certain regions, as well as taking in all available data that ranges from January 1, 2014 to December 31, 2016. GRACH Model is applied to 4 periods of stock market: before bull market, bull market, bear market, after bear market, respectively. The result shows that air quality doesn't influence people's enthusiasm towards stock market during bull market period. However, AQI has distinctly negative correlation with return rate of stock market.

articleTitle: Adjustment of industrial structure, urban-rural income disparity and sustainable development under a spatial spillover framework
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The article mainly studies the spatial effects of the adjustment of industrial structure on the urban-rural income disparity. The results show that: first, China's regional industrial restructure and urban-rural income disparity exists significant spatial dependence and spatial heterogeneity; Second, the adjustment of industrial structure has two has spatial effect on the urban-rural income disparity. And the last, an nonlinear spatial spillover effect exists between economy growth and urban-rural income disparity, the increase of urbanization rate has positive effects on reducing urban-rural income disparity and bring sustainable development.

articleTitle: Effects of altering transaction costs on the expiration-day effect of stock index futures
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: To discourage the intense fluctuations of stock index futures, CFFEX repeatedly altered futures policy and increased investors' transaction costs in 2015. With nonparametric tests, this paper compares the volume effect, volatility effect and price effect between expiration-day and non-expiration day, and then investigates the changes of expiration-day effect before and after the futures' adjustment. Abnormal trading volume in stock markets is not found on expiration-day, and the increase of transaction costs has no significant effect on volume effect. The expiration of CSI 300 stock index futures is associated with an increase in the volatility, but it is greatly weakened after the futures are restricted. This may be because the size of futures market decreases dramatically. No evidence suggests that price distortions occurred and the spot price moves along the original direction on the following trading day. This trend is strengthened after futures policy adjustment. Price shock are not found, and there are no obvious changes before and after the futures' adjustment.

articleTitle: Research on the development strategy modes and selections of Chinese outdoor jacket industry
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The study on development strategy mode of outdoor jacket in China will efficiently benefit the industrial transformation and strengthen the competitiveness of a company. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation on the adverse factors of outdoor jacket industry is done. Then, using SWOT-APH method calculated the ranking of optimal strategy. Based on the calculation results and combine with characteristics of Chinese outdoor Jacket industry chain, this paper proposes some development strategy modes for three different enterprises engaging in outdoor jacket - outdoor jacket makers, outdoor jacket branding companies and outdoor jacket retailers.

articleTitle: China railway technology efficiency measurement and optimization path analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the past 10 years, the scale of railway especially high-speed railway in our country has been expanding, the transportation equipment technology has been continuously improved, and how the efficiency of railway transportation enterprises has changed is a question worthy of further study. In this paper, 18 Railway Bureau are chosen as the research object, and we select 2005-2014 year panel data, using DEA nonparametric method for empirical analysis. The main research conclusions are as follows: (1) from the space dimension, the technical efficiency distributes uneven in spatial regions, and the railway efficiency in western area is obviously lower than the Middle East efficiency value, the main reason is the western region is with low traffic density and relatively high investment strength; (2) the main technical inefficiency of railway enterprises is due to the low pure technical efficiency, which is closely related with the 10 years of railway over investment and construction; (3) from the time dimension, the technical efficiency of all railway transport enterprises is gradually improvement and the main thanks to the passenger and cargo transportation and a series of reform initiatives in railway industry. In addition, the robustness test is carried out. The results show that the efficiency values of each enterprise are approximately the same, that is, these results are accepted by robustness tests, proving the stability and reliability. In the 13th Five-Year plan, our country should reduce the construction of high-speed railway; the existing railway industry should further improve the railway competition, improving competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Analysis on governmental intervention in the evolution of mixed ownership
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
