abstract: This paper explains the exact mechanism of governmental intervention in the process of economic system reform through the intervention index model and the evolutionary game model. The results show that the government should keep the principle of moderate guidance in the mixed ownership reform process under the consideration of both the political objectives and market efficiency. Meanwhile, the government should fully respect the market behavior of enterprise, and improve the supply side of the supporting system of mixed ownership gradually. Specifically to: (1) Transforming the functions of government. (2) Innovating the supply of institution. (3) Strengthening the protection of property rights. (4) Improving the administrative supervision.

articleTitle: Formal and informal credit markets and rural credit demand in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Credit markets play essential roles in financial institutions. In developing countries, especially in emerging market countries which are in the process of restructuring of industry, it is important to identify the reasons of credit constrains by an efficient way to facilitate economic transaction. On common phenomena in China rural credit markets is the informal credit market develop rapidly, it is very common for rural households to both through their networks. However it is inadequate in addressing rural credit needs. This research has 3 specific objectives: (1) Explore the relative importance of formal vs. informal rural credit markets in China (2) Identify factors determining households' choice of credit sector and the size of loan rural households borrowed from formal or informal credit markets. (3) Explore the degree to which households are constrained in credit access and identify the underlying factors. This paper also has some policy implications based on the empirical studies. The government can release the households constrain by making the formal credit more flexible and increasing the informal credit such as the microfinance for women.

articleTitle: The relationship among FDI, trade openness and economic growth: Empirical evidence from lao PDR
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to estimate the relationship between foreign direct investment (FDI), trade openess, and economic growth in Lao PDR. This article uses time series data from 1990 to 2015. To utilizeswith the most advance technique of bounds testing (ARDL) Cointegration Approach. More over, the Vector Error Correction (VECM) has been investigated to study the long run and short run association among variables. The outcome of this study reveals the positive sign on FDI and trade openness on economic growth in the long-run. According to the estimation of VECM model also reveals the unilateral direction in short run between foreign direct investment, labor force, capital investment and economic growth.

articleTitle: The dynamics of internationalization of the manufacturing industry in China a case study how networks affect SMEs' global strategies
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The globalization drives SMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises) — like big enterprises — to enter and act on foreign markets. Due to their limited resources SMEs are acting different compared to their big counterparts. Networks play a major role in the internationalization process of SMEs. Many studies have shown how networks affect the pre-phase and first foreign market entry but do not investigate how the internationalization progress continues. This study takes a closer look at the further internationalization process and shows how knowledge and experience are created for further market entries and how the additional knowledge influences the global strategy of SMEs in the Chinese manufacturing industry. Based on the knowledge management and the network approach this study uses a multiple case-study method to explore the knowledge absorption and strategy development which profit from the broad use of networks. The results of this study show that SMEs' networks play a significant role in the further internationalization process and influence the process. The SMEs' awareness of network relationships rises even though the use of network benefits happens mainly unknowingly.

articleTitle: The impact of institutional factors and capital market openness on short-term international capital flow
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the development of economic globalization, most of countries began to gradually open up their capital market, and improved relevant institutional environment. At the same time, short-term international capital flows caused much more crisis in emerging economies, which emphasizes the importance of the exploration into its influencing factors. This paper will focus on the study of economic institutional factors, including the interest rate policy, exchange rate policy, property rights institutional change, the degree of economic marketization, and the degree of capital market openness in the view of China, and the degree of capital market openness to figure out how to control short-term international capital flows fundamentally. By empirical analysis with VAR model establishment, impulse response functions and variance decomposition with relevant variables' quarter statistics covering 2000 to 2014, we can conclude that the factors above will influence the short-term international capital flow in each way.

articleTitle: The study on zombie firms in China using modified FN-CHK method
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This study modifies Fukuda Nakamura Caballero Hoshi Kashyap (FN-CHK) method to identify zombie firms by incorporating non-recurring gains and losses. The effectiveness of the proposed method is evaluated by existing unqualified companies and specially-treated companies in Chinese stock market. Based on the proposed method, this study analyzes the development trend, the proportion of zombie firms in Chinese listed companies from 2007 to 2015. The comparisons with the traditional methods justify the legitimacy of the proposed method. Furthermore, this study analyzes the result from perspective of macroeconomic environment and industries. Considering zombie firm issue, the study suggests that government should adhere to supply-side reform, properly deal with zombie firms existing for years, conduct industry policy carefully.

Author Keywords: fukuda nakamura caballero hoshi kashyap method

articleTitle: The impact of real effective exchange rate volatility on economic growth in the process of renminbi internationalization an empirical study based on VAR model
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the theoretical analysis of mechanism of exchange rate changes on economic growth, this paper examines the impact of real effective exchange rate volatility on economic growth over the period 1995-2014 in the process of RMB internationalization through establishing the VAR model. The results show a significant negative relation between the real effective exchange rate rise and import and export trade, but the time of the influence on the import is shorter than the export, therefore, in the long term, the increase of the RMB real effective exchange rate may cause a decline in net exports. The real effective exchange rate volatility has a negative impact on FDI both in the short term and long term, but the effect is not significant. Above all, the increase of the RMB real effective exchange rate may have a positive impact on economic growth in the short term, but in the long run, it will have a significant negative effect on economic growth. Therefore, we should pay more attention to the continued appreciation of the RMB brought about by the increase in international demand and establish relate measures to stable real exchange rate and maintain sustained economic growth on the basis of preventing the RMB exchange crisis.

articleTitle: The influence of university agglomeration on the high-tech industry development and employment growth
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Universities have important effect on the development of high-tech industry by the R&D (Research and Development) and the cultivation of talents. And university gatherings will expand this effect. So, this paper clearly analyzes the effect of Universities agglomeration on the High-tech Industry Development and Employment Growth. Firstly, this paper analyzes the conception of universities agglomeration and its influence mechanism on high-tech industry. Then, it presents double fixed effect model to trace the relationship between university agglomeration and the development of high-tech industry, further the impact of the university agglomeration and high-tech industry on the employment in the region by the panel data of 26 cities in China from 2009 to 2015. Finally, theoretical and empirical results have confirmed that the development of high-tech industry dose have great effect on the development of high-tech industry and the growth of regional employment.

articleTitle: Evaluation on green development ability of Chinese automobile manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Green development strategy is an important direction of the future industrial development in China, and the green development ability of automobile manufacturing enterprises is an important indicator to measure the green development of the industry. We use external presentation layer, business support layer, core layer to further explain the relationship between the enterprise's green development ability and suppliers, consumers and the public, which improve the theory system of green development ability. Under the guidance of the theory, this paper establishes an evaluation system from five dimensions, including green development concept, green production capacity, green innovation ability, green product and growth ability. Take 21 listed automobile manufacturing enterprises as an example; the empirical analysis is carried out. The result shows that the green development ability of Chinese automobile manufacturing listed companies is generally excellent. But the difference between enterprises is small. Enterprise need to focus on green product sales, improve dealer and consumer satisfaction, reduce defective product recalls, to enhance enterprise green development if wants to obtain competitive advantage.

articleTitle: The impact of urbanization and land intensive use on environmental pollution a case study on 35 cities in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Urbanization has a significant impact on environmental pollution, but the relationship between urbanization and environmental pollution is complex and dynamic. This study determines the relationships between the city population as well as the city area and the environmental pollution alone, moreover analyzing the joint action of the city and the level of land intensive use to the environmental pollution. In this study, data from 35 provincial capitals and sub provincial cities in China are selected from 2003 to 2013, and indicator system is constructed to evaluate the level of population urbanization, land urbanization and land intensive use. After testing the Heteroscedasticity across panels and Autocorrelation within groups of the panel data, employing the feasible generalized least squares (FGLS) to estimate the results. The conclusion of the study shows: a) in the process of Chinese urbanization, the relationship between economic development and environmental pollution is not always consistent with the environmental Kuznets curve; b) the population gathering in the city exposes a certain degree of negative impact to environment; c) the expansion of city area and intensive land use can reduce environmental pollution. According to the research results of this study, some suggestions on how to control the population size of the big cities in China, how to determine the appropriate the city size and population scale, and how to improve the level of intensive use of urban land are put forward.

articleTitle: Price determinants in China's pilot carbon markets
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper examines the determinants of carbon price in Hubei carbon market using VECM model. Six factors from three dimensions (international carbon price, energy price and exchange rate) are taken into account, both cointegration test and impulse response analysis are conducted to examine the long-run relationship and dynamic reaction of chosen variables. The result shows that long-run equilibrium exists among carbon price, energy price and dollar exchange rate. Innovations from EUAs, coal, natural gas and dollar exchange rate have negative influence on carbon price in the short-run, while innovations from crude and CERs will lead to positive responses.

articleTitle: Empirical estimation of civil aviation demand elasticity: The case of China Mainland
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the high-speed railway of large-scale construction and operation, people have alternative options on the long-distance, short-term demand for passenger transport. Factors affecting civil aviation demand elasticity including civil aviation route characteristics such as distance, civil aviation market structure, number of passengers and so on, end-point city characteristics such as urban population, per capita income level, tourism development level, major social and economic events such as 9.11, 2008 Crisis, etc., in addition to the above-mentioned factors have been explored in foreign countries, the development of domestic high-speed rail passenger transport to the formation of the substitution effect has reached the point cannot be ignored, based on the previous studies, this paper introduces the level of high-speed rail as the new influencing factor into the model of demand elasticity with the parallel line of civil aviation passenger line. The results show that the lower the price, the longer the distance, the higher the level of urban agglomeration, and the absence of financial shocks, the demand greater, meanwhile the higher the level of high-speed rail accessibility, similar to the lower demand for civil aviation passenger routes. This paper discusses the decisive factors of demand elasticity of civil aviation passenger transport in China Mainland under the new traffic situation, and provides strategic suggestions for civil aviation passenger transport pricing.

articleTitle: Linkage between remittances and FDI: Evidence from low-income countries
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The aim of this study is to get the rational answer about the relationship of foreign remittances with FDI inflows. In this research, we utilized panel data consists of a sample of 31 economies for the period of 1991-2015 by concentrating on the region of the low-income level. We applied popular methods to check the interaction of remittances with FDI which are known as panel co-integration analysis along with granger's causality test. Our outcomes indicate that remittance has long run significant and positive relationship with foreign direct investment and causality test revealed their side by side effect on each other. Empirical outcomes also indicate the noteworthy controlling effect of other variables in our model. Our study will certainly guide the financial institutes, policy analysts, financial analysts, researchers and organization of migration at the international level to take decisions linked to channelizing remittances efficiently.

articleTitle: Research of optimal timing of high speed rail construction in China based on urban panel data
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In 21st century, it has been observed significant development of high speed railways in China while there are arguments on optimal construction timing of high speed railways taking its lump sum investment, huge operation and maintenance costs into consideration. The mismatched construction timing leads to inefficient allocation of transportation resources and high opportunity cost that even cause negative impacts on regional, social and economic development. The paper establishes an optimal construction timing mechanism based on city economic condition, social condition and regional condition. Using with-or-without high speed railway (Hereinafter referred to as HSR) as the dependent variable, construction possibility is measured accordingly. The empirical results show that, urban economic features are the primary impact factors for high speed railway construction, of which, an average increase of 1% in disposable income will lead to 0.8% increase in possibility of the provision of high speed railways. Quantitatively speaking, RMB 80,000 per capita income is the threshold for the construction of HSR nationwide. Social and location characteristics alone cannot trigger HSR construction if other variables are kept constant in an average level.

articleTitle: An empirical study on China's early warning of financial risks under the new normal
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the financial security index calculated in the method of principal component analysis, this paper applies the model of BP neural network to test the result and then puts forward the early warning of Chinese financial security position in the future. In addition, the article gives some following suggestions for the early warning of financial risks: we shall reform the current financial regulation model to adapt to the real demand of mixed operation; we shall build a suitable financial risks' early warning system for China's reality; and the current “one bank and three commissions” shall strengthen inter-departmental coordination and enhance the joint forces of financial regulation on the basis of constantly improving the regulation means and technology.

articleTitle: Opportunities, evaluation and countermeasures of overseas development of Chinese book publishing industry
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper summarizes and analyzes the present situation of overseas development of Chinese book publishing industry. Opportunities for overseas development of Chinese book publishing industry include: Economic globalization, the growth of Chinese cultural industry, support and push for government policy, the trend of Chinese culture to the world. Through the construction of the book publishing industry overseas development rating model, put forward the overseas development of Chinese book publishing industry recommendations: Combined with national development strategies, Grasp the opportunity for leaders to visit, Build a book exhibition platform Book market overseas expansion in Southeast Asian countries.

articleTitle: Optimal layout and safety development of marine industry in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Existing research on layout of the marine industry is still at a scattered exploration stage, and results calculated with a relatively mature grey correlation method indicate that China is divided into three major industrial correlation regions with Shandong, Shanghai and Hainan as the core respectively while marine departments are still lack of correlation among them. According to calculation results of the Hector fender index, China's marine industry is at an upper level with moderate concentration as a whole while that of traditional marine industry is higher than newly emerging marine industry. In the future, in addition to perfecting laws and regulations related to the marine industry, measures should also be taken to speed up the construction of a national macroeconomic regulation and control system targeted at layout of the marine industry.

articleTitle: Path and risk analysis of innovation-driven development of construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Construction enterprises are faced with major changes of the construction industry and market, and innovation has become an important development measure for the construction enterprises to cope with the market crisis, expand the living space, and create a new profit point. This paper analyzes the necessity of innovation-driven development of construction enterprises, and puts forward the general direction and five mainly path of innovation. Finally, this paper analyzes the obstacles in the innovation process, and evaluates risk of innovation-driven development of construction enterprise based on AHP-Entropy weight-Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.

articleTitle: Product market competition, government control and cash flow risk evidence of Chinese corporations
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The examination of a sample of Chinese A-share listed companies demonstrated that product market competition holds an external governance mechanism, which can reduce corporate cash flow risk. Considering different hierarchies of government control, this paper finds that compared with nongovernment controlled and local government controlled enterprises, product market competition creates a stronger governance effect on enterprises that controlled by the central government. Further examination about the quality of local governments reveals in circumstances with higher local government quality, the governance effect of product market competition is relatively heavier, and cash flow risks of sample enterprises show a more obvious reduction.

articleTitle: Risk research on transnational merger and acquisition of Chinese petroleum enterprise based on cultural perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: China Petroleum enterprise overseas merger and acquisition is an important means to achieve overseas market expansion. Overseas mergers and acquisitions have great potential, but there are also unpredictable risks. Successful overseas merger and acquisition depends on how to identify, evaluate and control all kinds of risk that exist in the process of M& A. From the cultural perspective, China petroleum enterprises overseas merger and acquisition will inevitably face multiple cultural risks, such as the national culture, business culture and corporate culture. The paper analysis the main influence factors of different cultural risk on the basis of risk source recognition. Through stage identification and comparative analysis technique, cultural risk in each stage of merger and acquisition can be identified. Using SWOT risk analysis method, the impact of various cultural risks and the appropriate strategies can be analyzed and developed. Effective cultural integration is of great significance for controlling cultural risk and even achieving successful merger and acquisition. Cultural integration is a complicated process of cultural cognition, adaptation, integration and sublimation and runs through every stage of the overseas merger and acquisition. According to the cultural risk types in different stages and the degree of cultural strength, the corresponding cultural integration is adopted. The cultural integration is divided into four stages: cognitive stage, adaptive phase, integration stage and sublimation stage.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of the normalization of US anti-dumping investigation against China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In this paper, targeting the trade between China and the United States as the research object, we use the Poisson model and the game analysis method to do the empirical fitting of the anti-dumping trend. Based on the results, this paper argues that US anti-dumping investigations toward China tend to normalize, and this trend of normalization will exist for a long time. This trend will have an important impact on the development of China's various industries, especially in the development of industrial security.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of tight-money policy on corporate financing constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on listed companies in our country, this article explores the impact of tight money on corporate financing constraints by using cash-cash flow sensitivity model. This study finds that firms in our country usually face financing constraints, tight-money policy aggravates corporate financing constraints through bank lending channel, and meanwhile, no-tight-money policy alleviates corporate financing constraints. In order to relieve the corporate financing constraints, this paper considers that China's financial reform should advance the process of optimizing financial structure closely around the adjustment of banking structure, reduce the effects of corporate financing constraints influenced by bank credit channel, relieve the effect brought by the variation of monetary policy.

articleTitle: Analysis on the financial development level of internet
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The rise of the Internet is undoubtedly set off a new wave of technological revolution, to the development of human society to bring earth-shaking changes. Based on Internet thinking and technology, Internet finance also created a new situation in the development of the financial industry. From the point of view of innovation, this is not only the technical upgrading of the financial field, but also the emerging forms of participation of the economic activity actors in the era of progress, but also the changes in the financial system. Compared with traditional finance, it has a richer connotation and function, showing more Pratt & Whitney and democratic financial significance. Interpretation of Internet financial development cannot be limited to pay attention to the upgrading of trading technology, but also concerned about the transaction structure, changes in the contents of the agreement, and changes in financial power contract. Based on the present situation and trend of the development of Internet finance, this paper uses qualitative analysis and research methods to carry out qualitative analysis around three basic levels of Internet financial transaction technology, transaction structure and power contract, and then explores the information transmission and diffusion mechanism of Internet, Aiming at clarifying the logical driving force and path direction of the development of Internet financial development, grasping the development trend of the industry, and looking forward to the future development of the financial market, providing the thinking and reference for the economic actors.

articleTitle: The impact of trade facilitation on China's export trade analysis based on industries
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Under the strategy of open wider to the outside world of China's “One Belt and One Road” comprehensively, this study establishes a trade facilitation indication system and then carries out empirical analysis to the relationship between trade facilitation indicator and indication system, China's export trade, and the export of different industries through establishment of a complete trade facilitation indication system. Based on the gravitational model, it is found that, through the empirical analysis of the data in 49 countries and regions from 2007 to 2013, the trade facilitation plays a positive role in promoting the export trade. As for one of the four first-grade indicators of trade facilitation, infrastructure and information communication technology (ICT) is significant to the influence of sum of export trade. As to the export of different industries, the four indicators of trade facilitation have different effects on the export volume, among which the influence of infrastructure and customs environment on the export of different industries is consistent.

articleTitle: Study on the development of regional tourism industry under the influence of high-speed railway a case study of the middle reach of Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: According to the data about the shortest travel time of high-speed and conventional rail network from 10 cities, the domestic tourism income and the amount of domestic tourists in the middle reaches of Yangtze River area, this research will use the transportation accessibility in order to measure the spatial pattern of rail tourist transport accessibility in highspeed rail network. Based on the shortest travel time modified gravity model among 10 cities in high-speed rail network, the tourism economic linkage intensity, quantity, direction and breaking points are comprehensively estimated. And the highspeed rail's influence on the tourism linkage in the middle reach of Yangtze River area is identified. The result shows: Comparing with the existing lines, the tourist transport accessibility among cities is improved under the influence of high speed rail network, and the model presents a decreasing pattern from the central corridor to western wing and eastern wing. It shows the polarization effects of Wuhan and Changsha as the core of this region and there would be diffusion effect to some extent. The result of tourism economic linkage turns out the spatial distribution characteristics of this region. It shows that Wuhan and Changsha are the main cores and Nanchang is the vice core of this area, which constitute three major tourism economic circle.

articleTitle: Studies on influencing factors of China's anti-dumping
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Selecting the data from 1997 to 2015, by using Poisson regression to analyze the influencing factors of China's anti-dumping initiation and of China's anti-dumping affirmative ruling, this paper found out that when domestic firms initiated anti-dumping complaints and the Ministry of Commerce made anti-dumping rulings, their decisions were significantly affected by factors such as real GDP growth rate, unemployment rate, FDI growth rate, real effective exchange rate of RMB, China's entry into WTO and the number of anti-dumping cases suffered by China. When the domestic industries are damaged, finding out the rules of anti-dumping initiation and arbitration is of great practical significance for trade remedy and industrial security.

articleTitle: Financing mode and route choice of the elderly health industry in the Yangtze River economic zone
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Areas along the mainstreams of the Yangtze River are the largest inland industrial districts and manufacturing industry bases in the world, which have played an important and strategic role in China's social and economic development. Moreover, Hubei Province is in the center of the whole Yangtze River Economic Belt, it is an important foundation to achieve the nationwide regional division of labor and collaboration. As a new economic growth pole, international health industry bring billion of economic benefit. In this paper, we analyzed the financing model and the path selection of the elderly health services needs and the elderly health industry, the social and economic development status of the urban agglomeration of the Yangtze River economic zone in this dissertation. The author puts forward to give full play to the advantages of the Yangtze River Economic Zone, the construction of “medical support integration” of the elderly health industry demonstration base; Optimize the financing environment of the elderly health industry, and guide social capital to invest in the health of the elderly; Integration of preferential policies between the city group, to promote the healthy development of the elderly health.

articleTitle: Research on present security situation and development countermeasures of China's culture industry organizations
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: According to Industrial Organization Security Theory, this article defines the concept and influencing factors of culture industry organization security at the beginning. Then, the article points out the main factors threatening China's culture industry organization based on domestic and international situations. The first threat is caused by developed overseas cultural organizations because China's culture industry organizations' development is lagging. The second threat is caused by strong enterprises for the reason of abusing market power, which restricts the development of weak enterprises in domestic cultural market. And based on data envelopment analysis, evaluated the safety of cultural industrial organization in China. Lastly, the article makes some specific suggestions for protections of China's culture industry organization security.

articleTitle: Spatial distribution of human capital and its relationship with innovation efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the new normal context, regional human capital has become the main driver of economic growth. Through the construction of regional human capital evaluation system, factor analysis method is used to evaluate the regional human capital of 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government, and detect the relationship between regional human capital and innovation efficiency. The results show that the spatial distribution of regional human capital is still in an unbalanced state, and the innovation efficiency is increasing, but the overall level is not high and still needs to be further improved. The degree of spatial accumulation and the efficiency of regional human capital show the consistency of spatial distribution.

articleTitle: Research on the performance evaluation of fiscal expenditure under the background of SOE reform based on the railway industry in China
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Under the “new normal” of China's economy, in order to further optimize the structure of state-owned capital and to promote the reform of state-owned enterprises as well as to realize the maintenance and increase in value of state-owned assets, there was a major reform carried out in China's railway industry in 2013, then China Railway Corporation was formally established, which achieved the separation of government and enterprise. Although the separation of government and enterprise gives the self-management and self-operation of China Railway Corporation more liberation, the heavy debt burden and the sustained loss caused by the public welfare transportation expenditure severely restrict the rapid and sustainable development of China Railway Corporation. The solutions of these issues still need to be supported by the financial sector for railway public transport subsidies and railway construction funds. On the background of the major reform of railway industry and by analyzing the connotation of fiscal expenditure performance and the public welfare characteristics of railway industry, this paper finds out that the thought of combining the logic framework method and the balanced score card method can better understand the formation mechanism of the railway fiscal expenditure performance evaluation. Thus, we construct a four-dimension performance evaluation index framework, and finally build evaluation index system which is suitable for the railway industry.

articleTitle: A study on the mechanism of how land consolidation promote the economic growth and industrial transfer
publicationTitle: 2017 4th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Land is one of the most important factors that affect the economic growth. Studying on the theory of the problem that how land consolidation acts on the economy and industrial development will become a new research field along with the widely development of land consolidation projects in national scope. The article studies how land consolidation impacts on the economic growth through the economic growth model of three factors and explores the mechanism by which land consolidation acts on the industrial transfer between the developed and underdeveloped regions. The article concludes that the land consolidation can promote the economic growth and the industrial transfer as well as industrial updating effectively. Moreover, based on the theory analysis, the article offers three suggestions: the strategy of “differentiation”, “spatial integration” and “protecting ecological environment”.
